documented_diagnosis.name: Seborrheic keratosis
documented_diagnosis.evidence: Clinical diagnosis by the dermatologists who collected the dataset; not biopsied (PAD-UFES-20).

teaching_points: Seborrheic keratoses look stuck on the skin, with a waxy or warty surface.
They are benign and very common with age; many people have several.
Dark or irritated ones can resemble melanoma. One that changes or looks unlike the others needs assessment.

look_alikes.name: Melanoma
look_alikes.note: Irregular, multicoloured or changing over time.

look_alikes.name: Pigmented basal cell carcinoma
look_alikes.note: A shiny edge, sometimes with fine surface vessels.

look_alikes.name: Viral wart
look_alikes.note: A rough surface with tiny black dots.
